strings: Seedance AI Video Generator: Create Cinematic & Fluid Motion Videos

Create stunning AI videos with Lovart's Seedance model. Engineered for fluid motion and cinematic control, Seedance transforms text and images into high-fidelity videos perfect for ads, social media, and film.
Get started
The Power of Professional Video Generation
Text-to-Video Magic
Type a script, get a scene. Seedance interprets complex narrative prompts, translating words into rich, moving visuals instantly.
Image-to-Video Animation
Bring your Nano Banana or Midjourney images to life. Upload a static shot and use Seedance to add subtle motion like breathing, wind, or camera pans.
Camera Control
Be the cinematographer. Direct Seedance with commands like 'Zoom In', 'Pan Left', or 'Drone Shot' to get the exact framing you need.
Multi-Ratio Support
Create for any platform. Generate vertical videos (9:16) for TikTok/Reels or widescreen cinematic shots (16:9) for YouTube and TV.
4K Upscaling
Seedance output is crisp, but Lovart's integrated Upscaler can push it further to 4K resolution, making your AI video broadcast-ready.
Seamless Looping
Create perfect background assets. Seedance can generate seamless loops ideal for websites, VJ sets, and digital billboards.
Unleash Fluid Motion. Create Cinematic Videos with Seedance.

Stop settling for stiff, glitchy AI videos. Lovart's Seedance model is engineered for supreme motion fidelity and temporal stability. From complex choreography to high-speed automotive commercials, Seedance captures the physics of movement with breathtaking realism.
E.g., 'A cyberpunk street dancer performing in the rain, neon lights reflecting on wet pavement, slow motion, 4k cinematic'
High-Fashion Runway
A futuristic fashion model walking down a runway made of water, splashing effects, hyper-realistic texture
Fantasy Environments
Cinematic drone shot flying over a bioluminescent forest at night, glowing particles
Commercial Lifestyle
Close-up of a chef chopping vegetables in a busy kitchen, steam rising, dynamic focus pull
Automotive Action
A red sports car drifting around a corner on a race track, smoke and dust, dynamic angle
Pro Tip: Seedance excels at 'action'. Don't just describe a scene; describe the *movement* (e.g., 'camera pans right', 'hair flowing in wind').

Why Seedance is the 'Director's Choice' for AI Video
Supreme Motion Fidelity
Seedance doesn't just morph pixels; it understands physics. Whether it's a dancer's leap or a falling leaf, the movement is smooth, continuous, and free from the 'jitter' common in other models.
Temporal Stability
Keep your subject's face consistent from frame 1 to frame 100. Seedance locks onto identity and style, ensuring your video tells a coherent story rather than a shifting dream.
Cinematic Lighting Engine
Powered by advanced ray-tracing understanding, Seedance renders light that reacts to movement—shadows stretch, reflections shift, and volumetrics evolve naturally.

What is the difference between Seedance and other video models like Kling?

Seedance is optimized for high-dynamic motion and fluid aesthetics. While Kling is fantastic, Seedance often excels in scenes requiring complex choreography, rapid movement, or highly stylized cinematic lighting.
How long are the videos generated by Seedance?
Seedance typically generates videos of 5 seconds in duration (Standard Mode) but can be extended. You can also stitch multiple clips together in a video editor for longer sequences.
Can I control the camera movement?
Yes! Seedance supports natural language camera control. You can specify movements like 'pan right', 'zoom out', or 'tracking shot' directly in your prompt.
Is Seedance included in the free plan?
Seedance Lite is available for trial users with daily credits. Access to Seedance Pro 1.0 and 1.5, which offer higher resolution and better adherence, typically requires a subscription plan.
Can I use my own images as a starting point?
Absolutely. The Image-to-Video feature allows you to upload any image (generated by Lovart or your own photo) and animate it using Seedance's powerful motion engine.
